sections.heading: Learning Point 5
sections.content: FOREWORD The National Education Policy 2020 envisages a system of education in the country that is rooted in an Indian ethos and its civilisational accomplishments in all fields of knowledge and human endeavour.
sections.source_evidence: FOREWORD The National Education Policy 2020 envisages a system of education in the country that is rooted in an Indian ethos and its civilisational accomplishments in all fields of knowledge and human endeavour.

sections.heading: Learning Point 6
sections.content: At the same time, it aims to prepare students to engage constructively with the opportunities and challenges of the 21st century.
sections.source_evidence: At the same time, it aims to prepare students to engage constructively with the opportunities and challenges of the 21st century.

sections.heading: Learning Point 7
sections.content: The basis for this aspirational vision has been well laid out by the National Curriculum Framework for School Education (NCF-SE) 2023 across curricular areas at all stages.
sections.source_evidence: The basis for this aspirational vision has been well laid out by the National Curriculum Framework for School Education (NCF-SE) 2023 across curricular areas at all stages.

sections.heading: Learning Point 8
sections.content: By nurturing students’ inherent abilities across all five planes of human existence (pañchakośhas), the Foundational and Preparatory Stages set the stage for further learning at Middle Stage.
sections.source_evidence: By nurturing students’ inherent abilities across all five planes of human existence (pañchakośhas), the Foundational and Preparatory Stages set the stage for further learning at Middle Stage.

sections.heading: Learning Point 9
sections.content: Spanning from Grades 6 to 8, the Middle Stage serves as a critical three- year bridge between the Preparatory and Secondary Stages.
sections.source_evidence: Spanning from Grades 6 to 8, the Middle Stage serves as a critical three- year bridge between the Preparatory and Secondary Stages.

sections.heading: Learning Point 10
sections.content: For the Middle Stage, NCF-SE 2023 aims to equip students with the skills needed to grow, as they advance in their lives.
sections.source_evidence: For the Middle Stage, NCF-SE 2023 aims to equip students with the skills needed to grow, as they advance in their lives.

sections.heading: Learning Point 11
sections.content: It endeavours to enhance their analytical, descriptive, and narrative capabilities, and to prepare them for the challenges and opportunities that await them.
sections.source_evidence: It endeavours to enhance their analytical, descriptive, and narrative capabilities, and to prepare them for the challenges and opportunities that await them.

sections.heading: Learning Point 12
sections.content: A diverse curriculum, covering nine subjects ranging from three languages — including at least two languages native to India — to Science, Mathematics, Social Science, Art Education, Physical Education and Well-being, and Vocational Education promotes their holistic development.
sections.source_evidence: A diverse curriculum, covering nine subjects ranging from three languages — including at least two languages native to India — to Science, Mathematics, Social Science, Art Education, Physical Education and Well-being, and Vocational Education promotes their holistic development.

sections.heading: Learning Point 13
sections.content: Such a transformative learning culture requires certain essential conditions.
sections.source_evidence: Such a transformative learning culture requires certain essential conditions.

sections.heading: Learning Point 14
sections.content: One of them is to have appropriate textbooks in different curricular areas, as these textbooks will play a central role in mediating between content and pedagogy — a role that will strike a judicious balance between direct instruction and opportunities for exploration and inquiry.
sections.source_evidence: One of them is to have appropriate textbooks in different curricular areas, as these textbooks will play a central role in mediating between content and pedagogy — a role that will strike a judicious balance between direct instruction and opportunities for exploration and inquiry.

sections.heading: Learning Point 15
sections.content: Among the other conditions, classroom arrangement and teacher preparation are crucial to establish conceptual connections both within and across curricular areas.
sections.source_evidence: Among the other conditions, classroom arrangement and teacher preparation are crucial to establish conceptual connections both within and across curricular areas.

sections.heading: Learning Point 16
sections.content: The National Council of Educational Research and Training, on its part, is committed to providing students with such high-quality textbooks.
sections.source_evidence: The National Council of Educational Research and Training, on its part, is committed to providing students with such high-quality textbooks.

sections.heading: Learning Point 17
sections.content: Various Curricular Area Groups, constituted for this purpose, comprising notable subject-experts, pedagogues, and practising teachers as their members, have made all possible efforts to develop such textbooks.

sections.heading: Learning Point 18
sections.content: Ganita Prakash the textbook of Mathematics for Grade 7, Part II; aligns with the expectations of NEP 2020 and NCF-SE 2023, in respect of creating a spark for initiating mathematical thinking.

sections.content: This textbook designed for Grade 7 students, takes forward its journey through the world of mathematics that started in Grade 6.
